shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic figure with outstretched arms
justification: Both surfaces centre on a single frontal, highly schematic anthropomorphic figure with a vertical body axis and laterally extended arms, which is the only real correspondence and is a near-universal motif. A is a sculpted torso-and-head with elaborate carved regalia (headdress bands, pectoral disc, belt, incised scrolls and paired ornaments on the body), while B is a bare stick-like outline figure with a hooked head, no facial or costume detail, accompanied by an unrelated small comb-like or animal-like squiggle at lower left; the conventions of depiction and the density of iconographic detail are quite different.
